name: spectra
description: Explore three UI directions for your component, side by side in Cursor.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:extension
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src extension scripts vite.config.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-code-conventions.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --deny-warnings --fix src extension scripts vite.config.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-code-conventions.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build

spectra.openaiModel.description: OpenAI chat-completions model supporting JSON object output. API keys are stored separately in SecretStorage.

spectra.anthropicModel.description: Anthropic Messages model available to your API account. Change this when using a different supported model.

spectra.cursorModel.description: Cursor CLI model ID, or auto. Uses your Cursor CLI account, not the editor chat model. Use AI providers → Cursor account → List models for account model IDs.

spectra.cursorCliPath.description: Absolute path to the official Cursor CLI executable, without arguments. Empty uses ~/.local/bin/agent or ~/.local/bin/cursor-agent. Supported in macOS, Linux and WSL extension hosts.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only curated samples are available. Importing source and using AI require workspace trust.
